dedupe_keys.name: anchoring and connection design dataset for offshore floating photovoltaic systems in european waters surewave

description: This SUREWAVE dataset contains engineering design data for offshore floating photovoltaic systems protected by floating breakwaters. It includes metocean conditions, breakwater layouts, anchor-chain properties, catenary-mooring parameters, anchor-pile sizing and connection-load assessments. The source covers representative locations in the Baltic Sea, Mediterranean Sea and North Sea and supports the project deliverable on anchoring and connections to photovoltaic systems. These are concrete inputs and assessments for mooring and offshore renewable-infrastructure design. The related SUREWAVE metocean record describes environmental design criteria; this deposit also documents anchor, mooring and connection properties under a different native concept identity. Zenodo provides the resource landing page and metadata access. Thomas Pehlke of Clement Germany GmbH deposited one XLSX workbook, available free under CC BY 4.0. Parameter units and precise locations remain unknown in the inspected metadata. Transfer beyond the representative design locations and independent structural validation are not established by the description.
